rows.title: Things That Go Missing

rows.title: Things That Go Missing

rows.objective: Meet Iruga at the caravan camp in the Morroc Ruins. Read the copied transport manifest.

rows.title: The Desert Keeps Its Dead

rows.title: The Price of a Safe Road
rows.objective: Speak to Hald in Al De Baran. Read the three relief budgets here in Al De Baran. Then clear two marked Alarms on Clock Tower Floor2. Return here with the discrepancies.

rows.title: The Price of a Safe Road
rows.objective: Speak to Oren in Comodo. The performers have each written one missing name on a programme beside us. Read all three. The performance can be short; the people it names cannot be omitted.

rows.title: The Price of a Safe Road
rows.objective: Speak to Hald at the Alberta inn. Read Hald's signed protection order beside the table. The witnesses choose whether to use it. No one is required to join our guild to receive help.

rows.title: People Without Entries
rows.objective: Speak to Edda in the Juno archive. Veyr left one surviving cross-index here. Read it, then the shipping docket beside it. Edda will explain where the references disagree.

rows.title: People Without Entries
rows.objective: Speak to Sella in Lighthalzen. Two tampered Metalings guard the shelter's supply crates. Defeat them, then read the copy Sella has chosen to release. Her other testimony remains hers.

rows.title: People Without Entries
rows.objective: Speak to Takius in the service laboratory. Two discarded Removers protect the relay. Clear them, then read the three shutdown notes: identity, consent, return route. Use the service laboratory room.

rows.title: The Far Shore
rows.objective: Speak to Kaede in Amatsu. Find any three of four records: Amatsu's archive copy, Gonryun's terrace inscription, Louyang's family register, or Ayothaya's severance account. The journal names every location. Return here when three agree.

rows.title: The Far Shore
rows.objective: Speak to Fenris on the Gonryun terrace. Read Fenris's annotated copy beside her. It distinguishes a fragment from a person and describes what an anchor can damage.

rows.title: The Far Shore
rows.objective: Speak to Edda at the Alberta inn. Read the three returned consultation letters beside the guild table. Each community has approved its own part of the record; the dangerous binding procedure is not included.

rows.title: Those Who Answer
rows.objective: Speak to Miri near the Umbala passage. Read Miri's passage instructions and Haneul's marked return route. Follow the ordinary route to Niflheim; neither note replaces the local access requirements.

rows.title: Those Who Answer
rows.objective: Speak to the Witness in Niflheim.

rows.title: Those Who Answer
rows.objective: Speak to Yuufa at the Alberta inn.

rows.title: The Weight of a New Name
rows.objective: Speak to Fenris in the Juno archive. Read the preparation checklist beside Fenris. Complete any native job or rebirth quests you choose before returning; continuing your present career is an equally valid answer.

rows.title: The Weight of a New Name
rows.objective: Speak to Iris in Rachel. Read Iris's testimony in Rachel, then the equipment docket in Veins. Return to Iris to compare the two independent accounts.

rows.title: The Weight of a New Name
rows.objective: Speak to Nera in Veins. Read the unsent letter beside Nera. It explains the first shipment; it does not excuse a single later one.

rows.title: What the Fire Reveals
rows.objective: Speak to Dagna on Thor Volcano Floor 3. Defeat the marked Sword and Bow Guardians. Then release the three couplings beside the engineering station. Every career can operate these couplings; no particular spell is required.

rows.title: What the Fire Reveals
rows.objective: Speak to Fenris on Abbey Floor 3. Secure the Abbey relay by defeating its marked Necromancer and copying its register. Fenris has marked a relay beside the station; it opens once that register is copied. Take it to Thanatos's summit, defeat the marked Memory of Thanatos and copy the second register. Return to Fenris at the Abbey.

rows.title: What the Fire Reveals
rows.objective: Speak to Hald at the Alberta inn. Read the rescue dispatch beside the guild table. Every reserve companion has an evacuation, supply or road assignment; only three enter the breach with you.

rows.title: No One's Last Page
rows.objective: Speak to Veyr at the safe Morroc camp.

rows.title: No One's Last Page
rows.objective: Speak to the rescue group in the breach. Defeat the three marked sentries. Then secure the captives, disable the relay and open the exit in your role's stated order. A wrong operation closes the mechanism; it does not erase any completed rescue.

rows.title: No One's Last Page
rows.objective: Speak to Roan at the safe Morroc camp.

rows.title: The Names We Keep
rows.objective: Speak to Veyr at the final anchor.

rows.title: The Names We Keep
rows.objective: Speak to Veyr at the final anchor. Clear the wardens. Release the bindings: person, name, open door. Complete the final encounter.

rows.title: The Names We Keep
rows.objective: Speak to Hald in Prontera. Read the public hearing order beside Hald in Prontera. Then return to the Alberta guild hall for the homecoming. The prisoners and testimony remain the court's responsibility.
